# 🗒️ LC Prompt Builder

Modular prompt tools for ComfyUI. Build a clean **text prompt** and optional **Krea2 / Ideogram-style JSON** without drawing boxes by hand.

> Wire each block → **Assembler** → use **prompt** for normal conditioning, **json** for regional builders.

---

## 🔗 Basic flow

```
Subject(s) ──┐
Scene ───────┤
Camera ──────┼──► 🗒️LC Prompt Assembler ──► prompt  → CLIP / conditioning
Lighting ────┤                           ──► json    → Krea2 / Ideogram builder
Style ───────┤
Color palette┘
```

Optional: **🎲LC Wildcard** into a subject description (or any STRING) for random lines from `assets/wildcards/`.

---

## 👤 Subjects

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **🗒️LC Subject** | One person/character: description, pose, action, outfit, position (left/center/right, top/middle/bottom, foreground/mid/background). Live prompt at the bottom. |
| **🗒️LC Subject Array** | Merge several subjects into one string for the assembler (grows with connections). |

**Tips**
- Set **pose / action / outfit** to **none** when you type your own text or feed a wildcard.
- **Position** drives bbox placement in the JSON (thirds + depth). You can still move boxes on the Krea canvas later.
- Trailers like placement metadata are stripped from the readable **prompt**; they only feed the **json**.

---

## 🌆 Scene · 📷 Camera · 💡 Lighting · 🎨 Style

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **🗒️LC Scene Builder** | Preset environments + time of day + weather + optional extra notes. Detailed preset text; clashes with time/weather are cleaned up in the live preview. |
| **🗒️LC Camera** | Angle, distance (shot size), depth of field, optional free prompt. |
| **🗒️LC Lighting** | Lighting style + direction, optional free prompt. |
| **🗒️LC Style Selector** | Category, preset, quality level → style line for the stack. |

**Tips**
- Prefer presets for consistency; use the free **prompt** fields for one-off details.
- Scene still contributes **background text** even when scene bboxes are off.

---

## 🎨 Color palette

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **🎨LC Color Palette** | Preset swatches or sample colors **from an image**. Prompt text (hex list) + preview image. |

Image-node color (`#324B4B`). Use the **prompt** socket into the assembler **palette** input.

---

## 🎲 Wildcard

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **🎲LC Wildcard** | Pick a list under `assets/wildcards/`, output one random line (seed-stable). |

- **base_seed** + **seed_mode**: fixed / randomize / increment / decrement (works on partial runs).
- No seed output — plug **text** into subject description, join strings, etc.
- Lists are plain `.txt` files (one entry per line). Edit anytime; restart once if the dropdown is stale.

---

## 🧩 Assembler (the hub)

**🧩LC Prompt Assembler**

| Output | Use for |
|--------|---------|
| **prompt** | Human-readable stack → **CLIP / conditioning** (no regional builder). |
| **json** | Krea2 Regional / Ideogram-style **import_json** (structured caption + subject bboxes). |

| Widget | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| **pretty_print** | Indented JSON vs compact. |
| **remove_empty** | Drop blank sections. |
| **include_scene_bboxes** | **Off by default.** On = also emit furniture/landmark boxes from the scene. Off = **subject boxes only**. |
| **margin** | Inset all boxes from the frame edge (default **5%**). |

**Important**
- **Krea2 does not “read JSON” inside the model.** Builders parse JSON; the model still sees text + any regional conditioning those builders create.
- Plain path: **prompt → conditioning**.  
- Regional path: **json → builder →** that node’s outputs.


---

## ✅ Quick recipes

**1. Simple text-only (no regional)**  
Subjects + scene + camera + lighting + style → Assembler → **prompt** → CLIP.

**2. Multi-subject regional (Krea2)**  
Two+ Subjects (different positions) → Array → Assembler → **json** → Krea2 builder (outputs must be connected so it runs). Leave **include_scene_bboxes** off unless you want furniture boxes.

**3. Random outfit / action**  
Wildcard → Subject **description** (or outfit via your own wiring) → rest of chain.

**4. Palette from reference still**  
Image → Color Palette → Assembler **palette**.

---

## 📁 Editable assets

```
assets/wildcards/          ← .txt lists for 🎲LC Wildcard
assets/prompt_builder/     ← preset JSON (scenes, outfits, poses, scene objects, …)
```

No special `__wildcard__` syntax — just choose a file and get a line.

---

## 💡 Habits that save pain

- Fix seeds while dialing composition; randomize when exploring.
- Run the **assembler** (and the Krea builder) with outputs connected, or nothing updates downstream.
- For conditioning only, ignore **json**.
- For regional only, still keep **prompt** around for debugging what the stack “says” in plain language.

---

**"True, nothing is. Permitted, everything is"**  
_Yoda Auditore · Assassin's Wars_
